thread.title: VBA for calculating average cost of multiple portfolio transaction

author: sokar
title: VBA for calculating average cost of multiple portfolio transaction
text: VBA for calculating average cost of multiple portfolio transaction Hi everybody, I would need a VBA code to do the following: track the average cost of each item of my portfolio, according to the transaction type and transaction cost, sorting by date of course. For example, on the sheet1 I will have something like: Date Ticker Transaction Units Value 01.01.2017 APPL.O Buy 10 150 01.02.2017 FB.O Buy 30 100 15.03.2017 APPL.O Buy 20 160 16.03.2017 FB.O Sell 25 150 25.05.2017 APPL.O Sell 10 190 30.07.2017 FB.O Buy 3 120 08.08.2017 APPL.O Buy 20 130 And on the sheet 2, i would like the results for "units" and "average cost" : Ticker Units Avg. Cost AAPL.O FB.O 8 The point would be to have a VBA code to calculate automatically the process. I would just need to insert a multiple series of transactions, and after I can update automatically the number of units and the average cost of each stock. Thank you a lot for your help. Best regards
